{{Top|leg}}
The '''Combat Probot''' was a variant on the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]]. It was used by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agents on [[Centerpoint Station|Centerpoint]] and on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to prevent the sabotage on Centerpoint and the kidnapping of [[Aidel Saxan]] and [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]. It had built-in [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] and weaponry consisting of a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]]. They were painted bronze.
